about: ElevenLabs' API called as its demanded callers call it, with fetch and the xi-api-key header the World's credential door issues as ELEVENLABS_API_KEY: Raiku's voice server speaks a line as raw PCM at 24 kHz in Flash v2.5 (volter-ai/agent-stream voice/tts_server.py), and Volter Harness's setup-elevenlabs stores its custom voice server's credential as a workspace secret, provisions the voice agent with Harness's body (custom LLM, delegate and hand_off client tools, eleven_flash_v2 in pcm_24000, signed-URL auth, the prompt, first message and voice overrides) and asks the signed URL a voice joins on (volter-ai/supercode sdk/voice/providers/setup.mjs, elevenlabs.mjs). Neither caller pins an ElevenLabs SDK. The readback reads the agent and the secret's metadata back.
